# Pre-imputation Data Exploration

This chapter contains:

1. Missingness analysis
2. Sex/age adjustments

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(abcdutils)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(fastDummies)
library(patchwork)
library(visdat)
library(mice)

core_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/core")))
input_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/inputs")))
sub_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/subjects")))
fig_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/figures")))

mtbi_subs <- read_subjects(sub_path("2024_10_29_mtbi_subs.csv"))
uninj_subs <- read_subjects(sub_path("2024_10_29_uninj_subs.csv"))
```

```{r}
mtbi_df <- merge_df_list(mtbi_df_list)

base_mtbi_missing_pattern <- md.pattern(mtbi_df, rotate.names = TRUE)

glimpse(mtbi_df)

mar_check_df <- function(df, non_numeric_cols) {
    df <- df |>
        fastDummies::dummy_cols(
            select_columns = non_numeric_cols,
            remove_selected_columns = TRUE
        )
    mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(df), ncol = ncol(df))
    colnames(mat) <- colnames(df)
    rownames(mat) <- colnames(df)
    for (i in seq_len(ncol(mat))) {
        for (j in seq_len(nrow(mat))) {
            v1 <- colnames(mat)[i]
            v2 <- colnames(mat)[j]
            print(paste0(v1, " vs. ", v2))
        }
    }
}
mar_check(mtbi_df[, -1], c("latest_mtbi_mechanism", "race"))

mar_check <- function(v1, v2) {
    if (!any(is.na(v1))) {
        return(0)
    }
    v1_na <- as.numeric(is.na(v1))
    print(v1_na)
    print('vs')
    print(v2)
    cor(v1_na, v2, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
}

x1 <- c(NA, NA, 32, 2)
x2 <- c(NA, NA, 0, 1)

mar_check(x1, x2)

mar_check(x2, x1)



```

## Sex and Gender

The purpose of this subsection is to examine the distribution of children by their parent-reported genders and sexes at baseline with their own self-reported genders and sexes at the 3-year follow-up timepoint.

```{r}
gish_p_gi <- import("gender-identity-sexual-health/gish_p_gi.csv")
gish_y_gi <- import("gender-identity-sexual-health/gish_y_gi.csv")

mtbi_y_sex <- gish_y_gi |>
    filter_subjects(mtbi_subjects) |>
    filter_timepoint(t = 3) |>
    dplyr::select(
        subjectkey,
        kbi_sex_assigned_at_birth
    ) |>
    dplyr::rename(
        "y_sex" = "kbi_sex_assigned_at_birth"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(group = "mtbi", t = 3) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        y_sex = dplyr::case_when(
            y_sex == 1 ~ "M",
            y_sex == 2 ~ "F",
            TRUE ~ NA
        )
    )

uninj_y_sex <- gish_y_gi |>
    filter_subjects(uninjured_subjects) |>
    filter_timepoint(t = 3) |>
    dplyr::select(
        subjectkey,
        kbi_sex_assigned_at_birth
    ) |>
    dplyr::rename(
        "y_sex" = "kbi_sex_assigned_at_birth"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(group = "uninj", t = 3) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        y_sex = dplyr::case_when(
            y_sex == 1 ~ "M",
            y_sex == 2 ~ "F",
            TRUE ~ NA
        )
    )

mtbi_p_sex <- get_sex(
    gish_p_gi,
    mtbi_subjects,
    t = 0,
    as_numeric = FALSE,
    only_m_f = FALSE
) |>
    dplyr::mutate(group = "mtbi", t = 0)

uninj_p_sex <- get_sex(
    gish_p_gi,
    uninjured_subjects,
    t = 0,
    as_numeric = FALSE,
    only_m_f = FALSE
) |>
    dplyr::mutate(group = "uninj", t = 0)

mtbi_y_gender <- get_y_gender(
    gish_y_gi,
    mtbi_subjects,
    t = 3
) |>
    dplyr::mutate(group = "mtbi", t = 3)

uninj_y_gender <- get_y_gender(
    gish_y_gi,
    uninjured_subjects,
    t = 3
) |>
    dplyr::mutate(group = "uninj", t = 3)

mtbi_p_gender <- get_p_gender(
    gish_p_gi,
    mtbi_subjects,
    t = 0,
    match_y_report = TRUE
) |>
    dplyr::mutate(group = "mtbi", t = 0)

uninj_p_gender <- get_p_gender(
    gish_p_gi,
    uninjured_subjects,
    t = 0,
    match_y_report = TRUE
) |>
    dplyr::mutate(group = "uninj", t = 0)

y_sex <- rbind(mtbi_y_sex, uninj_y_sex)
y_gender <- rbind(mtbi_y_gender, uninj_y_gender)
p_sex <- rbind(mtbi_p_sex, uninj_p_sex)
p_gender <- rbind(mtbi_p_gender, uninj_p_gender)

y_report <- dplyr::full_join(y_sex, y_gender) |>
    dplyr::select(-t)

p_report <- dplyr::full_join(p_sex, p_gender) |>
    dplyr::rename("p_sex" = "sex") |>
    dplyr::select(-t)

sex_and_gender <- dplyr::full_join(
    y_report,
    p_report
)

sex_and_gender[is.na(sex_and_gender)] <- "NA"

sex_and_gender <- sex_and_gender |>
    dummy_cols(
        select_columns = c("y_sex", "y_gender", "p_sex", "p_gender"),
        remove_selected_columns = TRUE
    ) |>
    tibble()

sex_and_gender_mtbi <- sex_and_gender |>
    dplyr::filter(group == "mtbi")  |>
    dplyr::select(-group)

sex_and_gender_uninj <- sex_and_gender |>
    dplyr::filter(group == "uninj")  |>
    dplyr::select(-group)
```

### Gender Upset Plots

```{r}
gender_sets <- c(
    "p_gender_NB",
    "p_gender_NA",
    "y_gender_NB",
    "y_gender_NA",
    "y_gender_F",
    "y_gender_M",
    "p_gender_F",
    "p_gender_M"
)

gender_ints <- list(
    c("p_gender_M", "y_gender_M"),
    c("p_gender_F", "y_gender_F"),
    c("p_gender_F", "y_gender_NA"),
    c("p_gender_M", "y_gender_NA"),
    c("p_gender_F", "y_gender_NB"),
    c("p_gender_F", "y_gender_M"),
    c("p_gender_M", "y_gender_NB"),
    c("p_gender_M", "y_gender_F"),
    c("p_gender_NA", "y_gender_F"),
    c("p_gender_NA", "y_gender_M"),
    c("p_gender_NA", "y_gender_NB"),
    c("p_gender_NA", "y_gender_NA"),
    c("p_gender_NB", "y_gender_F"),
    c("p_gender_NB", "y_gender_NA"),
    c("p_gender_NB", "y_gender_NB")
)

uninj_gender_upset <- upset(
    sex_and_gender_uninj,
    gender_sets,
    intersections = gender_ints,
    name = "",
    sort_sets = FALSE,
    sort_intersections = FALSE
) +
    ggtitle("Uninjured") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 14))

mtbi_gender_upset <- upset(
    sex_and_gender_mtbi,
    gender_sets,
    intersections = gender_ints,
    name = "Gender Identity",
    sort_sets = FALSE,
    sort_intersections = FALSE
) +
    ggtitle("mTBI") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 14))

gender_upset_plots <- uninj_gender_upset / mtbi_gender_upset

gender_upset_plots

pdf(fig_path("gender_upset_plots.pdf", TRUE), width = 10, height = 10)
print(gender_upset_plots)
dev.off()
```

### Parent Report Upset Plots

```{r}

parent_sets <- c(
    "p_gender_NB",
    "p_gender_NA",
    "p_gender_F",
    "p_gender_M",
    "p_sex_IM",
    "p_sex_F",
    "p_sex_M"
)

parent_ints <- list(
    c("p_sex_M", "p_gender_M"),
    c("p_sex_F", "p_gender_F"),
    c("p_sex_F", "p_gender_NA"),
    c("p_sex_M", "p_gender_NB"),
    c("p_sex_F", "p_gender_NB"),
    c("p_gender_M", "p_sex_IM"),
    c("p_sex_M", "p_gender_F"), 
    c("p_sex_M", "p_gender_NA"), 
    c("p_gender_M", "p_sex_F")
)

mtbi_parent_sag <- upset(
    sex_and_gender_mtbi,
    intersect = parent_sets,
    intersections = parent_ints,
    set_sizes = FALSE,
    sort_sets = FALSE,
    sort_intersections = FALSE
) +
    ggtitle("mTBI") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 14))

uninj_parent_sag <- upset(
    sex_and_gender_uninj,
    intersect = parent_sets,
    intersections = parent_ints,
    set_sizes = FALSE,
    sort_sets = FALSE,
    sort_intersections = FALSE
) +
    ggtitle("Uninjured") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 14))

parent_sag <- wrap_plots(
    list(
        uninj_parent_sag,
        mtbi_parent_sag
    ),
    ncol = 1
)

pdf(fig_path("parent_sag", TRUE), width = 10, height = 10)
print(parent_sag)
dev.off()

```
